item: Root credentials of member accounts managed centrally from AWS Organizations (L2, Manual)
repo_note: Hub: none. Per-environment accounts exist; no rule puts them in an Organization or removes member root credentials.

item: Organization-wide authorisation guardrails (service and resource control policies) on every account (L2, Manual)
repo_note: Hub: none. Nothing denies unused regions, leaving the Organization or stopping the trail.

item: The Organizations management account runs no workloads (L2, Manual)
repo_note: Hub: none. The set names staging and production accounts only; nothing keeps the payer account empty.

item: Organizational units laid out by environment and data sensitivity (L2, Manual)
repo_note: Hub: none. Environments are split by account; no OU layout, and silo customer accounts need a place too.

item: A delegated administrator, not the management account, manages Organizations policies (L2, Manual)
repo_note: Hub: none. No rule.

item: Organization-integrated services administered from a delegated account (L2, Manual)
repo_note: Hub: none. No account named to administer Security Hub, GuardDuty, Config or Access Analyzer.

item: Account contact details kept current (L1, Manual)
repo_note: Hub: none. Contacts per account; an organisational process.

item: Security contact registered on each account (L1, Manual)
repo_note: Hub Account.1. The alternate contact can be set in infrastructure code; no rule asks for it.

item: No access key exists for the root user (L1, Automated)
repo_note: Hub IAM.4. No long-lived pipeline key; root is not named, and every member account has its own root.

item: MFA on the root user (L1, Automated)
repo_note: Hub IAM.9. Gap 3 of doc 33; once per account, not once per organisation.

item: Hardware MFA on the root user (L2, Manual)
repo_note: Hub IAM.6. No rule; a security key held by a named custodian.

item: Root user not used for administration or daily work (L1, Manual)
repo_note: Hub IAM.20 (FSBP only). Pipeline-only applies remove the need; no ban and no break-glass procedure.

item: Account IAM password policy requires at least 14 characters (L1, Automated)
repo_note: Hub IAM.15. 29 §2 sets the user pool policy, not IAM's; set the account policy even with no IAM users.

item: Account IAM password policy prevents reuse (L1, Automated)
repo_note: Hub IAM.16. As 2.8.

item: MFA for every IAM user with a console password (L1, Automated)
repo_note: Hub IAM.5. No rule requires MFA on staff accounts (CE-UAC-4).

item: Credentials unused for 45 days or more are disabled (L1, Automated)
repo_note: Hub IAM.22. No leaver or inactivity rule (CE-UAC-3).

item: Access keys rotated within 90 days (L1, Automated)
repo_note: Hub IAM.3. The pipeline holds none; human keys not banned; rotation is documented for secrets only.

item: IAM users get permissions only through groups (L1, Automated)
repo_note: Hub IAM.2. One role per deployable; no rule bans IAM users or policies attached to them.

item: No attached policy grants full "*:*" administrative access (L1, Automated)
repo_note: Hub IAM.1 (FSBP only). Function roles are narrow; the deploy role's scope is unstated and no guard test checks it.

item: A support role exists to manage incidents with AWS Support (L1, Automated)
repo_note: Hub IAM.18. No rule; one role in infrastructure code per account.

item: EC2 instances use instance roles for AWS access (L2, Automated)
repo_note: Hub: none. No EC2 in the design; applies if self-hosted runners run on EC2.

item: Expired TLS certificates removed from IAM (L1, Automated)
repo_note: Hub IAM.26. Certificates are provider-managed and renewed; none is uploaded to IAM.

item: IAM Access Analyzer for external access on in every region (L1, Automated)
repo_note: Hub IAM.28. No rule; per region per account, or one organisation analyser.

item: Human access managed centrally through federation or Organizations (L2, Manual)
repo_note: Hub: none. The pipeline is federated; no rule for staff console access.

item: AWSCloudShellFullAccess restricted (L1, Manual)
repo_note: Hub IAM.27. Least privilege covers deployables, not staff roles.

item: No resource policy grants unrestricted access with Principal "*" (L1, Manual)
repo_note: Hub S3.2, S3.3, Lambda.1, SQS.3, SNS.4, KMS.5. Guard test for buckets only; none for function, queue, topic or key policies.

item: Bucket policies deny requests that do not use TLS (L2, Automated)
repo_note: Hub S3.5. The edge redirects to HTTPS; no TLS-only deny on bucket policies, so a signed link works over HTTP.

item: MFA Delete on buckets (L2, Manual)
repo_note: Hub S3.20. Needs versioning (paid) and the root user to turn on; the pipeline cannot. Decide in a decision record.

item: Data in S3 discovered, classified and secured where needed (L2, Manual)
repo_note: Hub Macie.1 (FSBP only). Personal data declared per endpoint and per deletion list; nothing scans the buckets.

item: S3 Block Public Access on (L1, Automated)
repo_note: Hub S3.1, S3.8. Guard test per bucket; also set the account-level block in every account.

item: RDS encryption at rest (L1, Automated)
repo_note: Hub RDS.3. No RDS in Reference A; a relational store (Reference B) on RDS makes 3.2.x apply.

item: RDS automatic minor version upgrade (L1, Automated)
repo_note: Hub RDS.13. As 3.2.1.

item: RDS instances not publicly accessible (L1, Automated)
repo_note: Hub RDS.2. As 3.2.1.

item: RDS Multi-AZ deployments (L1, Manual)
repo_note: Hub RDS.5, RDS.15. As 3.2.1.

item: EFS encryption at rest (L1, Automated)
repo_note: Hub EFS.1, EFS.8. No file system in the design.

item: CloudTrail on in all regions (L1, Manual)
repo_note: Hub CloudTrail.1. No account or organisation trail rule; 33 §7 names the benchmark as unmapped.

item: CloudTrail log file validation (L2, Automated)
repo_note: Hub CloudTrail.4. Follows 4.1.

item: AWS Config on in all regions (L2, Automated)
repo_note: Hub Config.1. Security Hub needs Config for most checks; no rule turns it on.

item: Server access logging on the CloudTrail bucket (L1, Manual)
repo_note: Hub CloudTrail.7. Follows 4.1.

item: CloudTrail logs encrypted with a KMS customer-managed key (L2, Automated)
repo_note: Hub CloudTrail.2. 29 §7 keeps customer keys for named data; the trail is not on the list.

item: Rotation on customer-created symmetric KMS keys (L2, Automated)
repo_note: Hub KMS.4. Customer keys are required for upstream tokens; no rotation rule.

item: VPC flow logs in every VPC (L2, Automated)
repo_note: Hub EC2.6. No VPC in the design, but every region has a default VPC; delete it or log it.

item: Object-level write events logged for buckets (L2, Automated)
repo_note: Hub S3.22. Data events cost money and 29 §7 does not list them.

item: Object-level read events logged for buckets (L2, Automated)
repo_note: Hub S3.23. As 4.8; who read a member's file is the first breach question.

item: Access logging on every AWS-managed web front end (L1, Manual)
repo_note: Hub CloudFront.5, APIGateway.1, APIGateway.9. Paid tier logs the API edge; free-tier static sites have no logs by design.

item: Unauthorised API calls monitored (L2, Manual)
repo_note: Hub CloudWatch.2 (not in the CIS standard). Needs the trail in a log group; 15 §7 alerts on spend only.

item: Console sign-in without MFA monitored (L1, Manual)
repo_note: Hub CloudWatch.3 (not in the CIS standard). Needs 4.1.

item: Root user activity monitored (L1, Manual)
repo_note: Hub CloudWatch.1 (not in the CIS standard). The alarm that matters most with a root per account.

item: IAM policy changes monitored (L1, Manual)
repo_note: Hub CloudWatch.4 (not in the CIS standard). Only the pipeline role should change policy; alarm on anyone else.

item: CloudTrail configuration changes monitored (L1, Manual)
repo_note: Hub CloudWatch.5 (not in the CIS standard). Needs 4.1.

item: Console authentication failures monitored (L2, Manual)
repo_note: Hub CloudWatch.6 (not in the CIS standard). Needs 4.1.

item: Disabling or scheduled deletion of customer-created KMS keys monitored (L2, Manual)
repo_note: Hub CloudWatch.7 (not in the CIS standard). Losing the token key loses the data it encrypts.

item: S3 bucket policy changes monitored (L1, Manual)
repo_note: Hub CloudWatch.8 (not in the CIS standard). Needs 4.1.

item: AWS Config configuration changes monitored (L2, Manual)
repo_note: Hub CloudWatch.9 (not in the CIS standard). Needs 4.1 and 4.3.

item: Security group changes monitored (L2, Manual)
repo_note: Hub CloudWatch.10 (not in the CIS standard). No VPC is used, so any change is the signal.

item: Network ACL changes monitored (L2, Manual)
repo_note: Hub CloudWatch.11 (not in the CIS standard). As 5.10.

item: Network gateway changes monitored (L1, Manual)
repo_note: Hub CloudWatch.12 (not in the CIS standard). As 5.10.

item: Route table changes monitored (L1, Manual)
repo_note: Hub CloudWatch.13 (not in the CIS standard). As 5.10.

item: VPC changes monitored (L1, Manual)
repo_note: Hub CloudWatch.14 (not in the CIS standard). As 5.10.

item: AWS Organizations changes monitored (L1, Manual)
repo_note: Hub: none. Watch from the management account; needs an organisation trail.

item: AWS Security Hub on (L2, Automated)
repo_note: Hub: none. 33 §4 lists pipeline checks only; turn it on in every account and region.

item: EBS default encryption on in every region (L1, Automated)
repo_note: Hub EC2.7. No volumes in the design, but the check reads a free per-region account setting.

item: CIFS reachable only from trusted networks (L1, Automated)
repo_note: Hub: none. No instances and no security groups in the design.

item: No network ACL allows ingress from 0.0.0.0/0 to remote administration ports (L1, Automated)
repo_note: Hub EC2.21. The default VPC's ACL allows all inbound; fails until default VPCs are deleted.

item: No security group allows ingress from 0.0.0.0/0 to remote administration ports (L1, Automated)
repo_note: Hub EC2.53. Functions run outside a VPC; live the day one joins a VPC.

item: No security group allows ingress from ::/0 to remote administration ports (L1, Automated)
repo_note: Hub EC2.54. As 6.3.

item: The default security group of every VPC restricts all traffic (L2, Automated)
repo_note: Hub EC2.2. Default VPCs' default groups allow traffic; delete default VPCs or empty the group.

item: VPC peering routes are least access (L2, Manual)
repo_note: Hub: none. No peering in the design.

item: EC2 metadata service allows IMDSv2 only (L1, Automated)
repo_note: Hub EC2.8. No EC2 in the design; applies to EC2-hosted runners.

item: VPC endpoints used to reach AWS services (L2, Manual)
repo_note: Hub: none. No VPC; functions call services over public TLS endpoints.

item: Function resource policies allow no public invocation
repo_note: Permissions name the calling service and source; no guard test.

item: Functions run on a supported runtime
repo_note: Nothing retires an end-of-life runtime (gap 6 of doc 33).

item: Execution logging on REST and WebSocket stages
repo_note: Retention required; execution logging not named. Full request logging would break 17 §5.

item: Gateway associated with a WAF web ACL
repo_note: Firewall is on the distribution; turn off the default endpoint or the edge can be bypassed.

item: Every route declares an authorisation type
repo_note: Token verified at the gateway; anonymous routes show as NONE, so list them as evidence.

item: Access logging on API Gateway v2 stages
repo_note: Edge logs on the paid tier; stage access log not required.

item: Custom domain names use a recommended TLS security policy
repo_note: Minimum TLS set at the edge; the gateway's own domain not named.

item: Point-in-time recovery on tables
repo_note: Paid, so only where recovery is required; the guard test enforces that list.

item: Deletion protection on tables
repo_note: Guard test fails a table without it.

item: Default root object configured
repo_note: The client shell is served; no rule names the setting.

item: Viewers must use HTTPS
repo_note: HTTP to HTTPS redirect at the edge.

item: Distribution logging
repo_note: The API distribution on the paid tier logs; free-tier static sites cannot.

item: WAF on every distribution
repo_note: The flat-rate plan includes the ACL, even on the free tier.

item: No origin points at a bucket that no longer exists
repo_note: Bucket and distribution live in one module; no guard against a dangling origin.

item: Origin access control on S3 origins
repo_note: Origin access control plus block public access.

item: Recommended viewer TLS security policy
repo_note: Minimum TLS version set; record the policy name as evidence.

item: Identity pools allow no unauthenticated identities
repo_note: The design has a user pool and no identity pool.

item: Strong password policy on user pools
repo_note: Length-based; the control's defaults also want character classes, so set its parameters.

item: Threat protection in full-function mode for custom authentication
repo_note: A paid feature plan, not listed in 29 §7. Decide in a decision record.

item: MFA on user pools
repo_note: One-time-code second factor offered, not required.

item: Deletion protection on user pools
repo_note: Plan review keeps pools out of the destroy list; no setting and no guard test.

item: Server access logging on buckets
repo_note: Not required anywhere; start with the buckets that hold member files.

item: No ACLs used to grant bucket access
repo_note: Access is by policy and origin access control; no rule sets bucket-owner-enforced ownership.

item: Lifecycle configuration on buckets
repo_note: Deletion list exists; no lifecycle rule expires staged or abandoned objects.

item: Customer managed IAM policies do not allow decrypt on all keys
repo_note: Grants name exact resources; no guard on decrypt with "*".

item: Inline policies do not allow decrypt on all keys
repo_note: Inline policies are preferred, so this is the one that matters; no guard.

item: Keys not scheduled for deletion by mistake
repo_note: Plan review protects state; keys are not on the never-destroy list.

item: Key policies allow no public access
repo_note: No guard test over key policies.

item: Web ACLs hold at least one rule or rule group
repo_note: Five rules; the scanner guard test checks them.

item: CloudWatch metrics on WAF rules
repo_note: Not mentioned.

item: GuardDuty on
repo_note: Threat detection named in 33 §7, no rule; per account and region.

item: GuardDuty Lambda Protection on
repo_note: Watches function network activity; no rule.

item: Inspector standard scanning of Lambda functions
repo_note: Advisories checked at build; nothing rescans deployed functions.

item: Queues encrypted at rest
repo_note: Default encryption with a provider-owned key.

item: Queue policies allow no public access
repo_note: Grants name exact queues; no guard.

item: Topic policies allow no public access
repo_note: As SQS.3.

item: Configuration sets require TLS for sending
repo_note: SPF, DKIM and DMARC set; the TLS policy is not.

item: Customer managed policies use no service-wide wildcard actions
repo_note: Inline policies are preferred and this control does not read them; review those by hand.
